module.title: BuildFlow FSM
module.purpose: BuildFlow FSM delivers unified project oversight, field team coordination, and client communication for US construction and field service companies. It tracks projects, work tasks, labor time, material usage, and change orders to provide accurate job costing and operational dashboards. The module also generates AI-assisted status reports and client-facing billing summaries to keep stakeholders informed throughout the project lifecycle.
module.visualStyle: Desktop-first for PM and billing staff with mobile-optimized field entry; dashboard-driven, status-aware, touch-friendly UI with Gantt-ish timeline views.

entities.title: Project
entities.description: A construction or field service project with client, site address, budget, schedule, and lifecycle status that anchors all tasks, costs, and billing.

entities.title: Client
entities.description: External customer record referenced by projects; receives status reports, billing summaries, and invoices without internal editing access.

entities.title: Work Task
entities.description: A unit of work tied to a project, assigned to a field worker with a due date and progress status tracked through completion.

entities.title: Time Log
entities.description: An append-only record of hours worked by a field worker against a specific task, used for labor cost tracking and job costing.

entities.title: Material Usage
entities.description: An append-only record of materials consumed against a project for job costing, not full warehouse stock management.

entities.title: Change Order
entities.description: A formal document capturing a scope, cost, or schedule adjustment on an active project, with an approval lifecycle before it affects job costing and billing.

entities.title: Status Report
entities.description: An AI-assisted project status summary generated from live tasks, time logs, and materials, reviewed by the PM and shareable with the client.

entities.title: Delay Risk Suggestion
entities.description: An AI-generated advisory flag identifying a task at risk of delay, tied to a status report and referencing the specific work task without automatically changing its status.

entities.title: Billing Summary
entities.description: A client-facing breakdown of labor, material, and approved change order costs compiled by billing staff and shared with the client before invoicing.

entities.title: Invoice
entities.description: A formal billing document generated from approved job costs and change orders, sent to the client with payment processing handled externally.

relationships.description: Each project belongs to one client; a client may have multiple projects.
A project contains multiple work tasks that break down its scope.
A work task accumulates time logs recorded by assigned field workers.
A project accumulates material usage entries recorded for job costing.
A project may have multiple change orders adjusting its scope, cost, or schedule.
A project can have multiple status reports generated over its lifecycle.
A status report may include multiple delay-risk suggestions generated by the AI.
Each delay-risk suggestion references the specific work task flagged as at risk.
A project may have multiple billing summaries compiled over its lifecycle.
A project may have multiple invoices generated from approved costs.
An invoice may include multiple approved change orders as billable line items.
